Policy_A_Visual_Fallback_When_No_Prod.description: Visual candidate accepted only when production citation is absent

Policy_B_Deterministic_Threshold_Replace.description: Visual candidate replaces production candidate if confidence >= 0.80 and state matches

Policy_C_Explicit_Confidence_Competition.description: Visual candidate competes with production citation using scaled confidence

Policy_D_Strict_Boolean_Gating.description: Visual candidate restricted strictly to boolean fields with Section 9 bool type checking

morphological_wireframe.impact: Enables detection of light and broken borders in low-contrast scans

hough_diagonal_cross_filter.impact: Distinguishes handwritten X marks from solid check marks and dark fills

core_occupancy_ratio.impact: Excludes bounding border pixels to prevent border-thickness bias in state calculation

aspect_ratio_square_filter.impact: Excludes wide rectangular signature lines and narrative form slots (0.80 <= aspect_ratio <= 1.25)

canonical_selection: Policy A + Policy D (Policy A with strict boolean gating)
